scope:
Capture native SDK connector bodies, with synthetic replies over MockTransport.

No provider or MCP server is contacted. SDK serialization establishes the wire
shape, not live acceptance, cache behavior, provider token counts or charges.
Reported usage and the returned tool listing are explicitly synthetic controls.

findings.title: MCP tool context is not modeled
findings.detail: The MCP connector resolves tools on the provider side. Server connection settings and toolset configuration are not the loaded definitions or their model-facing rendering. Pinned lists and recorded listings remain inspectable, but this estimator does not implement their MCP rendering either. Visible text retains its counts; whole-request totals, context usage and sequence cache partitions and costs are unavailable. Nothing is fetched from a server URL, and captured provider usage is retained without inventing an estimated comparison.

findings.title: Cache breakpoint placed after content that changes
findings.detail: "message 1 (user) text" carries the automatic breakpoint (top-level cache_control), but it (or something before it) already differs from request 1. The breakpoint can only pay off once the content it covers is stable.
